Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614361. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614361, standard_value not null, and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
